approval_ref: v0.4.3 closure handoff V04-04-T01 under the capability-boundary report campaign

source_tasks.source_task: Build and validate the editable Codex-like feedback-loop workflow scenario.
source_tasks.authority: v0.4.3 closure handoff and capability-boundary report campaign.

source_tasks.source_task: Implement the shared F/G/X capability model and Builder Capability Build Contract, then rebuild option intake against it.
Introduce a versioned reusable module and verified-template registry.
Separate Customer Runtime, Engineer Studio, and Governance Console and expose platform task/cost/evidence views.
Productize Evaluation Harness profiles, scoped verification states, generated tests, and environment selection.
source_tasks.authority: Carried unchanged from v0.4.3; v0.4.4 implements only the Codex scenario profile slice.

source_tasks.source_task: Implement the daily web-collection pressure scenario on a durable job substrate.
Implement the customer-system embedding pressure scenario and Connector/Embedding SDK boundary.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Loop/Subflow exposes explicit initial state, state update, tool-result feedback, stop and cancel conditions, max iterations, per-iteration checkpoint, and per-iteration trace while the outer WorkflowSpec remains acyclic and existing Loop drafts remain compatible.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Schema validation, backward-compatibility tests, state/feedback/cancel runtime assertions, checkpoint records, and iteration events.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: A server-defined codex_like_workspace_agent template exposes context, planning, capability discovery, permission, sandbox, structured model-tool-result-model feedback, stop control, trace, and customer-facing answer as editable blocks without an opaque legacy agent node.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Template graph validation, nested-loop contract assertions, Builder template-list/expand coverage, and no legacy macro.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: A Codex scenario catalog entry declares E2/E3 boundary, runtime inputs, component evidence profile, generated scenario-specific acceptance cases, and can atomically replace a new draft under revision/hash guards without partial mutation.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Catalog/API schema tests, atomic apply and stale-guard tests, generated-test assertions, and draft validation.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: The creation experience offers a Codex-like workspace scenario, saving a draft applies the real editable preset, and the resulting Studio/Runtime path exposes task, workspace, network, approval, progress, and final result without claiming unrestricted host execution.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Frontend contract tests, API wiring, localized customer copy, TypeScript lint, and production build.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: A deterministic scenario run performs a real registered workspace Read tool call, feeds its normalized result into the next model turn, stops on a model final answer, returns that answer, and records permission, sandbox, two loop iterations, checkpoint, tool, and trace evidence; the result is labelled component_verified rather than live or production verified.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: End-to-end API run with deterministic provider and local sandbox, event/trace assertions, focused gate, regression suite, and evidence record.
